title: Granular metrics job settings object
summary: Documents the granular_metrics_job_settings object used with Redis Software REST API calls.

sections.title: Content
sections.text:
| Name | Type/Value | Description |
|------|------------|-------------|
| cron_expression | string (default: `* * * * *`) | [CRON expression](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cron#CRON_expression) that defines how often the [granular metrics](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/monitoring/metrics_stream_engine/local-metrics-storage#tiers) lifecycle check runs. The default runs it every minute. |
| enabled | boolean (default: true) | Indicates whether this job is enabled |
| granular_cleanup_delay | integer (default: 86400) | Number of seconds after granular collection stops before its data is deleted automatically |
| granular_max_duration | integer (default: 3600) | Number of seconds granular collection runs before it stops automatically |
